topic.title: Signal Classification and Anomaly Detection in Contested Spectral Environments

capture_decision.reason: The topic is Direct to Phase II and explicitly expects significant existing maturity and existing capabilities available for demonstration. Current repository evidence does not establish the requested RF classifier.

requirement_mapping.requirement: Run-time RF identification/classification faster than expert SIGINT analysts
requirement_mapping.minimum_evidence: Preregistered timed comparison on representative held-out RF scenarios against an expert or documented expert-analysis baseline
Modular feature/evidence attribution with repeatable why-output and analyst review

requirement_mapping.requirement: Scale from tactical to thousands of assets across domains/time horizons
requirement_mapping.minimum_evidence: Load test with explicit event rate, asset count, latency, memory, and degradation curves

requirement_mapping.requirement: Operate on modest CPU-based compute footprint
requirement_mapping.minimum_evidence: CPU-only training/inference or approved split benchmark with latency, throughput, memory, and energy measurements

requirement_mapping.requirement: Improve accuracy over time as additional data/resources are used
requirement_mapping.minimum_evidence: Versioned continual-learning or update protocol with held-out regression, catastrophic-forgetting checks, and provenance

requirement_mapping.requirement: CI/CD, automated testing, and containerized deployment
requirement_mapping.minimum_evidence: RF-specific pipeline built on existing SARA container/CI controls with classifier regression and security tests

lowest_cost_future_validation_path: Select a legally usable public RF modulation/signal dataset and freeze a train/validation/held-out split.
Implement an intentionally simple interpretable baseline such as engineered spectral features plus a small classical classifier.
Measure accuracy, unknown/anomaly detection, calibration, CPU latency, memory footprint, and explanation stability.
Add corrupted, novel, low-SNR, frequency-shifted, and distribution-shift challenge sets; retain failures as negative evidence.
Benchmark against a stronger model only after the simple baseline is reproducible.
Do not use simulated or public-data performance to claim SIGINT analyst superiority or operational contested-spectrum performance.
Seek a hardware/data partner with lawful representative RF capture and domain expertise before any D2P2 prime claim.
claims_boundary: No SIGINT data, classified RF data, operational C5ISR data, or government-provided RF corpus has been used.
No Worldshepherd RF signal classifier is currently claimed as implemented or validated.
Metasurface, S-parameter, RF propagation, or spectrum-adjacent research does not establish signal-classification maturity.

No expert-analyst speed advantage, operational accuracy, CPU-footprint compliance, C5ISR integration, D2P2 eligibility, partner interest, proposal submission, award probability, or government validation is claimed.
